Beyond immediate adaptation of social institutions, what lies ahead?
Forecasting is hard. Here’s an approach:
Identify a proposition of interest: “we do in fact, and we have reason to, live together quite peaceably without requiring constant coercion”.
Identify a theory to explain the voluntary social order.

III · WHO OWES WHAT TO WHOM
Beyond immediate adaptation of social institutions, what lies ahead?
Forecasting is hard. Here’s an approach:
Identify a proposition of interest: “we do in fact, and we have reason to, live together quite peaceably without requiring constant coercion”.
Identify a theory to explain the voluntary social order.
Identify its key assumptions, and ask whether AGI will undermine them.
This can vindicate our voluntary social order as well as place it in question!
